text.arabic_uthmani: أَفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَم بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۗ بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ وَٱلضَّلَٰلِ ٱلْبَعِيدِ

words.gloss_range: hostile interrogative Form VIII fabrication charge, with completed-action force and crafted false-attribution texture
words.root_gloss_range: cutting, shaping, and fabricated production; locally narrowed to a charge of contrived false attribution, not literal cutting
words.prose: The opening {{ar:أَفْتَرَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʾaftarā}}) launches the ayah inside a hostile question, and the prefixed hamza makes alleged fabrication arrive as a compact completed charge. Its final long ā holds the accused act before the target appears, while the root field pictures the warning as cut, shaped, and manufactured; the local pair with {{ar:كَذِبًا}} ({{tr:kadhiban}}) doubles crafted production with truth-breach. The charge belongs to a known false-attribution pattern against {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) (6:21), but here it is the deniers' frame that {{ar:بَلِ}} ({{tr:bal}}) will overturn.

topics.headline: hostile question opens the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins inside the accusers' framed question rather than with neutral narration.
topics.reason: The hamza-bearing perfect is locally parsed as the first half of the connected accusation frame that later reaches {{ar:أَم}} ({{tr:ʾam}}).

topics.headline: crafted false-production pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation imagines revelation as a contrived product, while local usage keeps the sense in false attribution rather than literal cutting.
topics.reason: The root family supports cutting and fashioning imagery, but Form VIII with {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) and {{ar:كَذِبًا}} ({{tr:kadhiban}}) narrows the live sense to fabricated attribution.

topics.headline: fabrication paired with divine attribution and lie noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening charge is maximized by combining forged attribution to God with an explicit lie label.
topics.reason: The rows cohere with the local attachment to {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) and the accusative {{ar:كَذِبًا}} ({{tr:kadhiban}}).

topics.headline: sharp and held acoustic opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surface form makes the accusation abrupt and held before its target is named.
topics.reason: The fused interrogative surface, final long vowel, and initial hamza all describe form-level pressure that survives without changing the lexical sense.

topics.headline: prior news recast as forgery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary move from reported news in 34:7 to an accusation of manufactured falsehood in 34:8.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives a concrete discourse shift from 34:7 into the opening charge of 34:8.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking hostile attribution upon the divine name
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) makes the alleged falsehood something placed upon or against {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}), not a neutral claim about God. Because the preposition stands between the fabrication verb and the divine name, the listener feels the imposed direction before {{ar:كَذِبًا}} ({{tr:kadhiban}}) names the false content.

topics.headline: upon as burdened attribution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation is shaped as an imposed claim against God, not merely a statement about God.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) governs {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}), and the semantic rows preserve burden and hostile direction.

topics.headline: separate preposition delays lie noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the syntax names the divine target before it names the lie, raising the charge's weight.
topics.reason: The word order and separate preposition keep the relation visible before the accusative content appears.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as genitive target of the alleged false attribution
words.root_gloss_range: worship, divinity, refuge, and orientation around the proper divine name; locally the unique named authority is in view
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) is the genitive target governed by {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), while {{ar:كَذِبًا}} ({{tr:kadhiban}}) supplies the alleged false content. The proper name makes the charge an offense against recognized divine authority rather than generic deity talk. The formula recalls false invention against God as grave wrongdoing (10:17), but the ayah uses that familiar pattern to show the deniers weaponizing it before their own denial of {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}) is exposed.

topics.headline: genitive target, not fabricated object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God is the target against whom the false claim is alleged, not the object being fabricated.
topics.reason: The prepositional attachment identifies {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) as the governed complement of {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}).

topics.headline: proper name fixes unique authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the charge invokes the unique divine name, so its stakes are public authority and accountability.
topics.reason: The surface is a proper noun rather than a common deity noun, and the rows consistently preserve singular authority.

topics.headline: formula of false invention against God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that speech about God and denial of final accountability are linked truth-claim fields in this correction.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah and local echo rows support the formulaic false-attribution background and the local bridge to {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}).

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative verbal noun naming false content, cognate force, or lying mode
words.root_gloss_range: non-correspondence, denial, falsification, and truth-breach; locally an accusative noun of alleged falsehood
words.prose: {{ar:كَذِبًا}} ({{tr:kadhiban}}) closes the first accusation as an indefinite accusative, so falsehood can be heard as the alleged product, manner, and truth-breach of {{ar:أَفْتَرَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʾaftarā}}). Its tanwīn cadence makes that first beat sound complete before the second alternative opens. The noun keeps one main act of fabrication while loading that act with non-correspondence rather than adding a second finite verb. Its pairing with the fabrication verb makes the deniers' accusation dense, but {{ar:بَلِ}} ({{tr:bal}}) redirects the real epistemic failure to those who do not trust the final horizon.

topics.headline: accusative falsehood as content and mode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the lie noun broadly labels the whole warned message as false, not only one specified statement.
topics.reason: The accusative verbal noun is licensed after {{ar:أَفْتَرَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʾaftarā}}) as object, cognate force, or manner.

topics.headline: non-correspondence and denial pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the charge is about reality mismatch and moral blame, while related denial forms remain background to the local noun.
topics.reason: The root family supports denial and deeming false, but the local surface is an accusative noun of alleged falsehood.

topics.headline: noun makes falsehood the forged product
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that falsity is packaged as the product of fabrication rather than narrated as a second action.
topics.reason: The noun form accounts for the formal rows without changing the clause structure.

topics.headline: fabrication cluster exposes mirrored failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers project falsehood onto the message, while the correction identifies their own refusal to trust as the deeper failure.
topics.reason: The local f-r-y/k-dh-b cluster and later correction rows jointly support the mirrored epistemic reversal.

topics.headline: first accusation beat lands on tanwīn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first accusation has a complete cadence before the second alternative begins.
topics.reason: The cadence and boundary rows add form-level closure and handoff into the next charge.

words.gloss_range: connected interrogative alternative linking fabrication and madness charges
words.prose: {{ar:أَم}} ({{tr:ʾam}}) keeps the madness clause inside the same hostile diagnostic frame as the fabrication clause. It does not start a neutral second question; it forces the warning into an either-or box of intent or incapacity until {{ar:بَلِ}} ({{tr:bal}}) cancels the whole pair.

topics.headline: fabrication or madness as one frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two accusations are coordinated alternatives, so the correction rejects a whole diagnostic box.
topics.reason: The particle links the opening hamza question to {{ar:بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌ}} ({{tr:bihi jinnatun}}) as a connected hostile alternative.

topics.headline: standalone alternative particle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the forced choice as a visible hinge before the corrective turn.
topics.reason: The standalone particle carries the alternative relation without needing a repeated interrogative prefix.

topics.headline: alternative remains live until cancelled
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:بَلِ}} ({{tr:bal}}) does not choose one branch; it overturns both.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly tie the force of {{ar:أَم}} ({{tr:ʾam}}) to the later corrective particle.

words.gloss_range: fronted prepositional predicate with 3ms suffix anchoring the alleged condition to the accused man
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) puts the accused bearer before the word for madness, so the man's interior becomes the first target of the second slander. The bāʾ marks state or accompaniment, and the audible 3ms suffix reaches back to the man in 34:7, keeping the unnamed accused figure present inside the diagnosis. When {{ar:بَلِ}} ({{tr:bal}}) turns to the plural deniers, that singular focus is reversed.

topics.headline: accused bearer foregrounded before diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the alleged condition is attached to the man before the condition is named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) as the fronted predicate before delayed {{ar:جِنَّةٌ}} ({{tr:jinnatun}}).

topics.headline: bāʾ makes madness lodged with him
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation imagines an inward condition lodged with or in him, not only an external insult.
topics.reason: The preposition can carry state and accompaniment in this predicate construction.

topics.headline: singular target shifts to plural judges
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the suffix targets one accused man from 34:7, while the correction moves scrutiny to the accusing group.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence supplies the 34:7 antecedent, and discourse rows track the later plural reversal.

topics.headline: pronoun fused and heard in the slander
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accused person remains surface-visible and audible even though unnamed.
topics.reason: The fused preposition-pronoun form and boundary rows preserve the personalizing texture of the accusation.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative delayed subject naming alleged madness or hidden derangement
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealment, unseen beings, gardens, shields, and mental veiling; locally narrowed to a polemical accusation of cognitive covering
words.prose: {{ar:جِنَّةٌۢ}} ({{tr:jinnatun}}) completes the fronted predicate as an indefinite delayed subject: the slander says a hidden condition is with him, not that he performs an act. The broad {{ar:ج ن ن}} ({{tr:j-n-n}}) covering field is narrowed here to mental veiling, turning concealment into stigma. The doubled nūn and tanwīn compress the sound of the second accusation just before the corrective break. The charge is not isolated: it is directly denied elsewhere (68:2), and Sabaʾ later negates the same kind of claim in 34:46.

topics.headline: unspecified condition, not performed act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that madness is cast as an unspecified condition lodged with him rather than an action he does.
topics.reason: The nominative delayed subject after the fronted predicate supports the condition reading.

topics.headline: concealment field becomes mental veiling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the broad covering root being weaponized as cognitive stigma, while local grammar keeps only the madness branch active.
topics.reason: The j-n-n family is broad, but the surface noun in this clause licenses the mental-veiling accusation.

topics.headline: noun diagnoses state rather than deed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusers move from alleged false speech to alleged inward condition.
topics.reason: The nominal form makes the charge a state diagnosis, and the local echo with {{ar:كَذِبًا}} ({{tr:kadhiban}}) gives the outer/inner pair.

topics.headline: later and wider negations of madness charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this insult belongs to a recognized charge that the Qur'an elsewhere rejects (68:2; 34:46).
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete inter-ayah parallels and same-surah recurrence without making them govern the local syntax.

topics.headline: nasal compression closes the second charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second accusation closes with a compact nasal sound before the corrective break.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows describe surface texture that reinforces the closed slander without adding lexical claims.

words.gloss_range: corrective particle rejecting the accusation frame and installing the counter-diagnosis
words.prose: {{ar:بَلِ}} ({{tr:bal}}) is the ayah's hinge: it does not merely add an answer, but rejects the whole fabrication-or-madness frame. Its compact form snaps the discourse after the accusation pause, and its final kasra leans straight into the new subject. After this small corrective particle, the speech mode moves from public ridicule and direct hostile questioning to declarative counter-statement: the focus shifts from one accused man to the plural class who do not believe in the Hereafter, and the pair of hostile diagnoses is replaced by punishment and far straying.

topics.headline: whole accusation frame overturned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the text rejects both accusations together rather than defending against them one by one.
topics.reason: The particle follows both alternatives and introduces a new counter-identifying clause.

topics.headline: short particle snaps into new subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the corrective turn as abrupt and immediately joined to the new subject.
topics.reason: The compact form and final kasra support the recitational lean into {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}).

topics.headline: diagnosis of him becomes verdict on them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural reversal from two accusations against him to two predicate domains over them.
topics.reason: The rows link {{ar:بَلِ}} ({{tr:bal}}), the plural relative subject, and the {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) predicate into one diagnostic reversal.

topics.headline: mockery overridden by declarative correction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the speech-mode shift from public ridicule and direct hostile questioning into authoritative counter-statement.
topics.reason: The boundary rows trace the move from 34:7 reported ridicule to 34:8 interrogation and correction.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun forming the corrective subject from the following refusal clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: singular pronoun phrase in the accusation

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the corrected subject a definite class identified by what follows: they are those who do not believe in {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}). The plural relative form shifts scrutiny away from the singular man targeted by {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) and onto the responsible group judging him.

topics.headline: relative clause names the group by refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the correction identifies people by their ongoing refusal, not by tribe, rank, or vague crowd identity.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is subject of the corrective sentence and is specified by {{ar:لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:lā yuʾminūna}}).

topics.headline: plural judges replace singular target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pathology rebounds from the one accused man to the collective accusers.
topics.reason: The number shift from {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) to {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) is discourse-significant and locally licensed.

words.gloss_range: negation particle scoping over the indicative belief verb in the defining relative clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the indicative imperfect {{ar:يُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yuʾminūna}}), so the clause describes a standing refusal rather than issuing a prohibition. Its separate surface keeps polarity visible before the belief verb and binds that refusal to the precise object {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}).

topics.headline: ongoing non-belief, not command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the correction diagnoses a settled posture of non-belief, not a momentary or commanded action.
topics.reason: The negator precedes an indicative imperfect, preserving descriptive negation.

topics.headline: negation visibly binds verb and Hereafter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied object is precise: trust fails specifically toward the Hereafter.
topics.reason: The separate negator leaves verb morphology intact while binding the verb to the following governed complement.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect 3MP belief/trust verb, negated as ongoing collective refusal
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, entrusting, and verified confidence; locally belief as trust in the governed Hereafter-domain
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yuʾminūna}}) carries the plural group's ongoing act of trust, but {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) turns it into their defining refusal. The hamza inside the belief word creates a small arrest within the negated clause, matching the break in trust that defines the group. The {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) field makes belief more than assent: it is trust, security, and commitment to the final horizon. By negating the familiar {{ar:يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:yuʾminūna bil-ākhirati}}) formula, the ayah explains why their judgment becomes straying rather than guidance (2:4; 34:21).

topics.headline: imperfect plural names continuing posture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation rebounds onto a collective, ongoing refusal rather than one isolated mistake.
topics.reason: The indicative imperfect 3MP resumes {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) and remains descriptive under negation.

topics.headline: belief as trust in secure final truth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that refusing the Hereafter is refusal to trust a secure truth-horizon, while local grammar keeps the sense to belief with {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}).
topics.reason: The root field supports safety and entrusting, but the local Form IV construction selects belief/trust toward a governed object.

topics.headline: Hereafter-belief formula negated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a known guidance marker is inverted into the diagnostic boundary for punishment and far error.
topics.reason: Rows with 2:4 and 34:21 show the belief-in-Hereafter formula as a sorting pattern that is negated here.

topics.headline: lack of trust becomes loss of orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the semantic antithesis: without trust in final accountability, judgment becomes lostness.
topics.reason: The local contrast between trust-language and straying-language is directly supported by the rows.

topics.headline: hamza arrests the negated belief clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small acoustic break inside the belief word that suits the clause's broken trust.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is form-level and does not overrule the lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: belief-complement preposition linking the negated verb to the Hereafter
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the small hinge that attaches belief to its object: {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}). Because the particle is segmented as its own word, the correction visibly targets a severed trust-relation, not generic skepticism.

topics.headline: preposition marks the denied domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unbelief has a defined object: the final realm.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) governs {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}) as the complement of {{ar:يُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yuʾminūna}}).

topics.headline: adhesive trust relation fails
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices belief as an attachment of trust to an object, which negation severs.
topics.reason: The bāʾ can function as object marker after belief while preserving attachment pressure.

topics.headline: split particle keeps relation visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the governed phrase as one complement even though the preposition is split as its own word.
topics.reason: The bundle segmentation and grammar support the visible relation without splitting the meaning.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive Hereafter as the precise domain of refused belief
words.root_gloss_range: laterness, finality, what comes behind or last; locally the known final accountability realm
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}) is the definite genitive complement after {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), so the corrected problem is refusal of the known final accountability horizon. The audible hamza after the article gives this final horizon a distinct entry after the preposition. The {{ar:أ خ ر}} ({{tr:ʾ-kh-r}}) field gives the word sequence pressure: what comes last gives measure to what is judged now. Placed before {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}) and {{ar:ٱلضَّلَٰلِ ٱلْبَعِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-ḍalāli al-baʿīdi}}), the denied Hereafter becomes the hinge between their accusation and the verdict.

topics.headline: known final horizon, not vague after-stage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refusal targets a known accountability realm, not an undefined future idea.
topics.reason: The definite noun is governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) as the belief-domain.

topics.headline: laterness gives present judgment its measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denying what comes last collapses the measure by which present claims should be judged.
topics.reason: The root field includes laterness and sequence, but the local noun names the final realm rather than verbal delay.

topics.headline: feminine definite noun makes a realm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Hereafter as a substantive domain, not a loose temporal afterthought.
topics.reason: The form turns the later into a definite realm and contrasts with verbal delay forms.

topics.headline: denied Hereafter yields punishment and far error
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah inverts a guidance formula: denial of the final horizon leads into punishment and remote error.
topics.reason: The rows connect belief in the Hereafter with guidance (2:4) and punishment consequence in the local sequence.

topics.headline: diagnosis before consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second half gives the defining defect before naming the enclosed consequence.
topics.reason: The relative clause containing {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}) precedes the {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) predicate.

topics.headline: later horizon and final distance linked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same-surah finality thread and the local contrast between denied laterness and far straying.
topics.reason: The rows provide same-surah references and the local echo to the closing distance adjective.

topics.headline: hamza gives the final horizon distinct entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word's distinct recitational entry after the preposition.
topics.reason: The form-level row contributes sound texture without changing the governed-complement role.

words.gloss_range: predicate preposition locating the deniers inside punishment and far error
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) supplies the predicate without an overt copula, locating the deniers inside {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}) and {{ar:ٱلضَّلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-ḍalāli}}). Its containment sense lets the wording hold present state and outcome sphere together. The same preposition reverses the mockery of being in new creation in 34:7: the mockers are now described as enclosed in punishment and far error.

topics.headline: preposition predicates enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers are located in a condition, not merely told about a later event.
topics.reason: The preposition introduces the predicate phrase for {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) without an overt copula.

topics.headline: one fī governs punishment and error
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices punishment and far error as one compact field of consequence and failed orientation.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) governs the coordinated predicate domains.

topics.headline: small free preposition carries enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how much predicate force is compressed into a small independent particle.
topics.reason: The surface form makes enclosure visible without requiring a written copular verb.

topics.headline: 34:7 new-creation containment rebounds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the containment mocked in 34:7 is turned back on the mockers in 34:8.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives the concrete 34:7 phrase and its reversal in the present predicate.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive punishment as first governed domain under fī
words.root_gloss_range: torment, punitive affliction, and the relief/sweetness contrast of the root field; locally the punishment branch is active
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}) is the first genitive domain governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), so punishment is not a loose theme but the first enclosure in which the deniers are placed. Its definite verbal-noun shape turns punitive action into an inhabitable condition. The {{ar:ع ذ ب}} ({{tr:ʿ-dh-b}}) field can carry sweetness and relief contrasts, but locally the punishment branch dominates, making the consequence feel like deprivation of relief as well as penal affliction. Because it follows the denied Hereafter, the punishment domain answers refused finality and then joins misguidance as a paired verdict.

topics.headline: first enclosed punitive domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices punishment as the first governed domain of the verdict, not a vague consequence theme.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) and precedes the coordinated error domain.

topics.headline: verbal noun makes punishment inhabitable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment is presented as a sphere they are in, not only an action that may later be done to them.
topics.reason: The nominal form under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) supports the state or domain reading.

topics.headline: torment branch with relief-deprivation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices punishment as affliction shadowed by loss of relief, while local syntax keeps torment as the selected branch.
topics.reason: The root field includes sweetness and torment, but the definite noun here activates punitive consequence.

topics.headline: punishment answers denied finality and joins error
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment and misguidance function together as the answer to refusing the Hereafter.
topics.reason: The local sequence and co-occurrence rows link {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}), {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}), and {{ar:ٱلضَّلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-ḍalāli}}).

words.gloss_range: additive conjunction coordinating far error under the same fī predicate
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pulls {{ar:ٱلضَّلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-ḍalāli}}) into the same {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) predicate as {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}). The conjunction is additive rather than sequential, so the deniers are located in punishment and far error together, not first in one and then in the other.

topics.headline: error joined under same enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment and error share one locative predicate.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates {{ar:ٱلضَّلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-ḍalāli}}) with {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿadhābi}}) under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}).

topics.headline: not sequence or simple cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices punishment and far straying as simultaneous aspects of one predicament rather than a temporal sequence.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly exclude a sequencing paraphrase and preserve additive coordination.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive misguidance/error coordinated under fī and modified by far
words.root_gloss_range: lostness, straying, misorientation, causing or judging astray; locally an abstract inhabited state of far misguidance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلضَّلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-ḍalāli}}) is the second governed domain under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), and {{ar:ٱلْبَعِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-baʿīdi}}) attaches to it specifically. The assimilated article gives the definite noun a doubled emphatic onset, making the straying sound heavy and fixed. The {{ar:ض ل ل}} ({{tr:ḍ-l-l}}) field keeps a lost-road image inside the abstract noun, so refusal of the final horizon becomes misorientation rather than mere error. The wording echoes the prayer to avoid the astray (1:7) and makes the accusers already inside a far form of that lostness.

topics.headline: second enclosed domain modified by far
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that remoteness qualifies straying itself and that error is an inhabited domain under the same predicate.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms coordination under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) and adjective agreement with {{ar:ٱلْبَعِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-baʿīdi}}).

topics.headline: pathloss image within abstract unbelief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices non-trust in the Hereafter becoming navigational failure, while local form keeps this as abstract misguidance.
topics.reason: The root field supports lost-road imagery; the local noun under {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) selects the abstract state.

topics.headline: state, not merely persons astray
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deniers are enclosed in misguidance as an environment rather than merely labeled as people who stray.
topics.reason: The abstract noun form differs from an active participle and works naturally with {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}).

topics.headline: far misguidance as recurrent verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that lostness is stretched into remoteness, forming the ayah's map of unbelief as remote misorientation.
topics.reason: Rows link {{ar:ٱلضَّلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-ḍalāli}}) with {{ar:ٱلْبَعِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-baʿīdi}}) and with the negated belief clause.

topics.headline: astray-prayer and Sabaʾ sorting echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 34:8 places the deniers in a state that 1:7 asks to avoid, while Sabaʾ keeps sorting truth-claims through orientation language.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references to 1:7, 34:24, and 34:50 without changing the local parse.

topics.headline: assimilated emphatic onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the definite straying noun as heavy and fixed in sound.
topics.reason: The assimilated article is a surface feature supporting sound texture.

words.gloss_range: definite qualitative adjective modifying misguidance with remoteness
words.root_gloss_range: spatial, temporal, social, and moral distance; locally remoteness from guidance and recoverable correction
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَعِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-baʿīdi}}) completes the noun phrase by agreeing with {{ar:ٱلضَّلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-ḍalāli}}), so the final distance belongs to straying, not to the paired punishment. As a qualitative adjective, it gives that remoteness as a settled condition rather than an event of becoming distant. The {{ar:ب ع د}} ({{tr:b-ʿ-d}}) field makes that distance spatial, temporal, and moral: the error is far from return and correction. As the last word, its long ī and final d stretch the closure, while the shared genitive cadence binds punishment, error, and distance into one predicate ending. It turns the opening accusation back onto the accusers, leaving the ayah on their remoteness rather than on the messenger's alleged confusion; 50:3's far return is inverted into far straying here.

topics.headline: remoteness attaches to straying
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final adjective narrows onto error specifically, not punishment.
topics.reason: Agreement in definiteness and genitive case ties {{ar:ٱلْبَعِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-baʿīdi}}) to {{ar:ٱلضَّلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-ḍalāli}}).

topics.headline: distance as hard-to-recover error
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the error is evaluated as far from guidance, return, and reliable judgment, while local syntax keeps it as an adjective of misguidance.
topics.reason: The root field supports broad distance, but the modifier relation narrows it to remoteness of straying.

topics.headline: qualitative adjective, not event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices remoteness as the straying's settled quality rather than an event of becoming distant.
topics.reason: The qualitative adjective form supports a stable characterization.

topics.headline: distance and straying recur together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final phrase is a verdict-pattern of far misguidance, with 50:3's far return reversed into far straying.
topics.reason: The rows provide the b-ʿ-d/ḍ-l-l pairing and the concrete 50:3 contrast.

topics.headline: last word returns diagnosis onto accusers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends not with the charge against the messenger but with the accusers' distance from guidance.
topics.reason: The closure rows tie the final adjective to the opening accusation reversal.

topics.headline: long ī and genitive cadence seal closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing cadence stretching and binding punishment, error, and distance into one predicate ending.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows support a surface-level cadence payoff without adding semantic branches.

topics.headline: Sabaʾ distance and belatedness thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this final word participating in Sabaʾ's broader concern with distance, delay, and unreachable return.
topics.reason: The same-surah recurrence row is coherent background and does not control the local modifier relation.

topics.headline: final adjective completes the predicate phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the predicate does not stop at error; it lands on remote error as the refined condition.
topics.reason: The row preserves the final word's structural completion role.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative "did he fabricate against God a lie, or is there madness in him?" is overturned by "rather, those who do not believe in the hereafter."
baseline_models.mechanism: The first clause offers a closed diagnosis of the messenger: deliberate false construction or reason covered by madness. The adversative rejects both horns and relocates the diagnostic problem in the accusers' refusal to entrust the later horizon, so their act of classification becomes evidence of their own deviation.

activation_trace.role: Fabricated falsehood supplies the first horn as intentional construction of an untruth.
Contradiction of truth specifies what the alleged construction is said to produce.
Reason covered by madness supplies the second horn as impaired rather than intentional speech.
Heart-settling assent identifies the rejected hereafter as the accusers' own failed epistemic act.
Laterness after the first gives the disputed report its deferred horizon.
Departure from guidance turns the accusation back into a diagnosis of the accusers' orientation.

changed_reading.before: The speaker must be either lying about resurrection or mentally impaired.
changed_reading.after: The binary diagnosis is itself rejected: refusal to trust the later horizon discloses the accusers, not the messenger, as badly oriented.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The accusers are described locatively as "in the punishment and the far error," not only as people who will later receive them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The locative construction places them within a present condition whose full consequence belongs to the later horizon. Punishment, hiddenness or loss, and distance form an enclosure that impairs recognition now; futurity is the disclosure of a condition already inhabited rather than its simple beginning.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the horizon across which the present condition will become manifest.
Painful punishment supplies the consequential environment in which the verse locates the unbelievers.
Hiddenness and disappearance make error a condition that can conceal itself from its inhabitant.
Distance from nearness gives the error a spatial and epistemic geometry.

changed_reading.before: The verse predicts future punishment and labels the accusers generically misguided.
changed_reading.after: It depicts them as already enclosed in a self-concealing, distance-producing condition whose punitive reality is disclosed across the later horizon.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacent roots of fabrication, lying, and madness also carry images of stitching, a deceptive garment, and covering.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch-level material model treats falsehood as an assembled cover: pieces are cut and joined into an appearance that conceals rather than reveals. On this reading, the accusation says the messenger has fitted such a cover over speech about God, while the adversative raises the possibility that the accusers' own binary is the fitted cover.

activation_trace.role: Cutting for repair and stitching supplies fabrication as the joining of selected pieces into a made surface.
A garment that deceives by its condition supplies the false appearance produced by that assembly.
Covering from perception supplies concealment as the assembled surface's functional effect.

changed_reading.before: Fabrication is simply inventing a false proposition.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, fabrication is selective assembly into a plausible covering, and the verse reverses the question of whose representation is doing the covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence puts total material tearing beside new creation, surrounds it with knowledge of what is hidden down to every particle, and then asks the deniers to see the field around them. This revises "far error" into a perceptual inference: what has dispersed beyond sight is treated as beyond recovery, although hiddenness and distance do not place it outside knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Disappearance within something supplies the focus error's mistaken equation of invisibility with nonexistence.
Distance supplies the focus diagnosis as a failure of access and orientation.
What is screened from eyes supplies the hidden domain that nevertheless remains exhaustively known in the ayah.
Tearing into scattered pieces supplies the material state from which the mockers infer non-recoverability.
Newness occurring after a cutting supplies the counter-image in which discontinuity can precede renewed creation.
Seeing by eye and insight supplies the demanded corrective to inference from what is no longer visible.

structural_cues: 34:3 denies that even a particle, smaller or larger, escapes knowledge or the clear record.
34:7 places total tearing and new creation inside the mockers' own report.
34:9 immediately asks them to inspect what lies before and behind them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden particles, tearing followed by newness, and a demand to see; I infer that the mockers move from dispersal and invisibility to impossibility of return. A live alternative is that 34:9 only threatens them and does not expose the logic of their denial.

changed_reading.before: Far error is a general doctrinal distance from belief in resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Far error is specifically the bad inference that matter dispersed beyond sight has also escaped knowledge, measure, and recoverability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Davidic craft sequence turns resistant iron pliant and orders linked armor by measure; the Saba sequence turns measured, secure routes into requested distance and then total fragmentation. Together they activate a join-versus-break mechanism in the focus: constructive fabrication measures and connects pieces, whereas far error asks for separation until the social body is torn.

activation_trace.role: Cutting for repair and stitching anchors the focus verb to constructive assembly as well as accusatory invention.
Softness opposed to rough resistance supplies the material transition that makes reworking possible.
Hard iron supplies the resistant material that is transformed rather than discarded.
Deliberate measured ordering supplies the rule by which separate parts become a sound whole.
Piercing and linking rings or hide supplies the concrete image of joined discrete pieces.
Actively creating distance supplies the choice that reverses secure connection into separation.
Tearing and scattering into pieces supplies the social result of requested distance and echoes 34:7.

structural_cues: 34:10-11 moves from hard iron through softening and measure to connected armor.
34:18-19 moves from measured secure travel through a request for greater distance to total fragmentation.
The exact tearing formula in 34:19 echoes the resurrection mockery in 34:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two ordered transformations and the repeated tearing formula; I map their material and social arrows onto the focus contrast between fabrication and far error. The live alternative is that the craft and Saba sequences are independent exempla rather than a commentary on the accusation's wording.

changed_reading.before: Fabrication is verbal invention, while far error is an abstract moral distance.
changed_reading.after: The accusation misnames ordered reassembly as false fabrication, while the accusers' own orientation acts as anti-linkage: it produces distance, breaks measured relations, and ends in fragmentation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes madness from actual hidden beings, then denies that those beings possess hidden knowledge when a material collapse exposes their ignorance; it later distinguishes worship of them from belief in them. The focus's madness label therefore reads less as an explanation than as an opaque causal attribution whose evidential warrant has not been tested.

activation_trace.role: Covering of reason by madness supplies the accusers' proposed hidden cause of the messenger's speech.
Actually hidden beings supply a distinct, observable category whose work does not entail knowledge of the hidden.
Emergence into visibility supplies the disclosure produced by the collapse of a material support.
The hidden beings become the subjects whose epistemic limitation is exposed.
What is screened from eyes supplies the knowledge those beings demonstrably lacked.
Assent directed toward the jinn supplies a later example of commitment to a hidden-agent account.

structural_cues: 34:12 presents jinn as workers under permission rather than autonomous knowers.
34:14 lets an ordinary material event reveal that the jinn did not know the unseen.
34:41 separately names worship of jinn and belief in them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence, observable work, a material disclosure, and denied unseen knowledge; I infer a critique of using an unseen mental cause to explain away unusual speech. Alternatively, the later passages may only disambiguate jinn from madness without commenting on standards of diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: The second horn straightforwardly alleges insanity.
changed_reading.after: It also exposes an evidential maneuver: absence of an answer is hidden behind a causal label, while the surah insists that claims about hidden agency remain answerable to disclosed effects.

context_deltas.mechanism: A conjecture becomes true through being followed, doubt distinguishes the nonbeliever, guidance is obstructed, disbelief is commanded continuously, regret is concealed, and the process terminates in collars. Far error is thus not only private confusion; it is a distributed loop in which suggestion recruits following, hierarchy maintains obstruction, and repeated compliance hardens into constraint.

activation_trace.role: Assent that settles the heart anchors the focus failure whose social production the later sequence exposes.
The later horizon supplies the object around which following and doubt divide the community.
Departure from guidance anchors the resulting network as error rather than neutral affiliation.
Uncertain supposition supplies the initiating expectation that gains force through response.
Following in another's track supplies the behavior by which conjecture realizes itself.
Two possibilities interpenetrating without settled certainty supplies the unstable state opposed to hereafter belief.
Turning and diverting supplies the leaders' disputed role in blocking access to guidance.
Demand backed by obligation supplies the interpersonal pressure to disbelieve.
Hiding something inwardly supplies regret that remains concealed until punishment is seen.
A collar that binds the body supplies the terminal materialization of socially maintained constraint.

structural_cues: 34:21 explicitly denies Satan coercive authority, preserving responsibility inside the social mechanism.
34:31-33 stages reciprocal blame between the weakened and the self-exalting.
34:33 locates the scheme across night and day before hidden regret and collars appear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjecture, following, denied coercive authority, reciprocal blame, commands, concealment, and collars; I infer a causal loop from suggestion through social reinforcement to constraint. The alternative is a simpler moral sequence in which each item is parallel evidence of guilt rather than a single mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Not believing in the hereafter is an isolated intellectual failure.
changed_reading.after: The far error is socially inhabited: uncertain suggestion becomes an apparently confirmed world through following, obstruction, command, and concealed complicity, without eliminating individual responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus alleges that the messenger attaches a lie to God. Later, unsupported claims about beings besides God are stripped of ownership and participation, the accusers are asked to display those they have attached as partners, and clear recitation is again called an inverted, fabricated falsehood. The predicate "fabricated against God" therefore rebounds as a projection from their own attachments onto the message that challenges them.

activation_trace.role: Fabricated falsehood anchors the charge whose agency is progressively reversed.
Contradiction of truth supplies the alleged content attached to God.
The worshipped God supplies the object against whom the false attachment is alleged.
Speech without certainty supplies the accusers' own unsupported claim about other powers.
Ownership and disposal supply the capacity explicitly denied to the claimed powers.
Participation supplies the share in cosmic agency explicitly denied to them.
Attaching an entity to an affiliation supplies the accusers' act of joining partners to God.
Association with God names the status produced by that attachment.
Turning a thing away from its proper direction supplies the inversion by which clear signs are renamed falsehood.
The repeated fabricated-falsehood formula shows the focus charge becoming a stock response to recited signs.

structural_cues: 34:22 tests the claimed powers by ownership, participation, and support.
34:27 asks the accusers to show the partners they attached to God.
34:43 repeats fabricated falsehood while linking the challenge to inherited worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unsupported claims, denied capacities, attached partners, and the repeated accusation; I infer rhetorical projection from the accusers' own additive theology onto the message. The alternative is that the passages merely refute two separate propositions without assigning the same fabrication mechanism to both.

changed_reading.before: The verse records a one-off allegation that the resurrection report was falsely attributed to God.
changed_reading.after: The allegation is a recurrent defensive inversion: people who attach unsupported partners and inherited commitments to God call the dislodging message the attached falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repetition of "there is no madness in your companion" is preceded by a procedure: rise for God, in pairs and individually, then think. Pairing and solitude vary the social conditions of judgment, while long companionship supplies an evidential history. The focus's lie-or-madness binary is therefore answered not by a counter-label but by a method for checking it.

activation_trace.role: Reason covered by madness anchors the diagnosis that the later procedure tests.
Rising with resolve supplies the deliberate break from passive group repetition.
Joining one person to one supplies a small reciprocal setting for checking judgment.
The solitary individual supplies an independent setting free from immediate group reinforcement.
The heart's repeated consideration supplies the cognitive work replacing instant diagnosis.
Sustained companionship supplies accumulated observable evidence about the accused person.
The exact madness sense is repeated under negation as the conclusion of the prescribed examination.

structural_cues: 34:46 repeats the focus phrase about madness almost verbatim under negation.
The order is commitment, paired and solitary examination, reflection, then judgment about the familiar companion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired and solitary settings, thought, companionship, and the repeated negated diagnosis; I infer a de-biasing procedure that checks both crowd contagion and solitary self-confirmation. Alternatively, pairs and individuals may simply universalize the exhortation rather than prescribe distinct epistemic controls.

changed_reading.before: The adversative simply asserts that the accusers, not the messenger, are wrong.
changed_reading.after: The surah later operationalizes that reversal: suspend the crowd's binary, vary the social setting, inspect the known person, and think before assigning hidden pathology.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence contrasts God casting truth with people casting speech at the unseen from a distant place. Guidance arrives by hidden communication from a Lord described as near; capture is from near, but belated belief cannot be reached from far, and a barrier finally blocks desire. "Far error" becomes an epistemic trajectory: unsupported verbal projection creates distance until access to the desired correction fails.

activation_trace.role: Departure from the intended path anchors the closing sequence as the anatomy of error.
Distance from nearness anchors the focus adjective to the closing access geometry.
Casting words supplies the authorized projection of truth that opens the final contrast.
The speaker's conditional personal erring supplies accountable ownership rather than diagnostic projection onto others.
Knowledge imparted in hidden form supplies the channel by which guidance reaches the speaker.
Nearness opposed to distance places the hearing Lord close to the guided speaker.
Failure of attainment or escape supplies the collapse of access at the moment of alarm.
Nearness supplies the place from which accountability reaches them despite their epistemic distance.
Extending to take and reach supplies the now-impossible retrieval of belief.
Distance supplies the position from which belated assent cannot be grasped.
Casting words and accusations supplies their speculative counterpart to the truthful casting in 34:48.
What is screened from sight supplies the target at which they throw claims without access.
The repeated distant place makes their speech's epistemic position explicit.
A barrier separating two things supplies the final hardening of distance into blocked desire.

structural_cues: 34:48 and 34:53 repeat the same casting verb with truth and the unseen as contrasting objects.
34:50 places personal error against guidance by hidden communication and ends with nearness.
34:51-54 alternate near capture, distant failed retrieval, distant speculation, and final separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored casting, near guidance and capture, distant speculation and failed retrieval, and a terminal barrier; I infer a trajectory in which speech without access produces the distance it presumes. The alternative is that the near/far language is only eschatological timing and place, not a model of present knowing.

changed_reading.before: Far error means severe or extensive moral deviation.
changed_reading.after: Far error is a position produced by throwing claims toward what one cannot access; it grows into practical non-retrievability even while truth, hearing, and accountability remain near.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form and syntax strongly support fabrication from ف ر ي, while the packet also preserves a non-dominant ف ت ر target. It remains packet-anchored and changes the accusation's mechanism, but downstream prose should present it only as split-root associative pressure, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The first horn "أفترى" maps in the packet not only to ف ر ي but also to the non-dominant ف ت ر inventory.

activation_trace.role: Weakening and stillness after intensity supply a form-distant image of lapse or attenuation within the first accusation.
Covered reason supplies the second horn and lets the split-root image blur the accusers' sharp moral-versus-medical binary.

changed_reading.before: The alternatives are cleanly separated as intentional lying or madness.
changed_reading.after: At the packet's split-root edge, the first horn also carries a faint image of lapse after intensity, exposing the accusation as a continuum of depreciative labels rather than a stable diagnosis.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-material reading is surprising because it links distant branch images rather than lexical senses in one clause. It remains anchored in the focus's deceptive-garment and protective-cover branches and gains a visible armor-to-collar sequence in context; render it as a qualified analogy about rhetorical function, not as word meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes a lie branch imaged as a deceptive garment with a madness root that also contains protective covering.

activation_trace.role: A garment that misrepresents its condition supplies accusation as a surface that deceives while covering.
A protective shield supplies the accusation's defensive function against the disturbing resurrection report.
A long, ample covering supplies the context's beneficial form of complete protection.
A collar binding the body supplies the reversal in which defensive enclosure hardens into restraint.

changed_reading.before: Calling the report a lie or madness merely dismisses it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the dismissal functions as protective rhetorical clothing: it screens the accusers from the report, but the same enclosing logic eventually appears as a bond rather than protection.

strongest_changes: The tearing/newness sequence makes resurrection denial a mistaken equation of dispersal with irrecoverable loss.
Measured linked craft and Saba's requested distance turn fabrication versus far error into a coherent joining-versus-fragmentation mechanism.
The repeated madness phrase is answered by paired and solitary reflection on a known companion, replacing a label with a checking procedure.
The closing mirrored casting and near/far sequence turns far error into failed epistemic access produced by speculation at the unseen.
Unsupported partners and the repeated fabricated-falsehood charge make the focus accusation rebound as projection.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence preserves unusually exact relays: total tearing in 34:7 and 34:19, madness in 34:8 and 34:46, fabricated falsehood in 34:8 and 34:43, active distance in 34:19 and inaccessible distance in 34:52-53, and truthful versus speculative casting in 34:48 and 34:53. These relays convert a compact rebuttal into material, social, procedural, and spatial mechanisms without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The cutting-and-linking craft model is strongly branch-anchored but depends on a reader-supplied analogy across separated exempla.
The projection model is rhetorically coherent, but the packet does not itself state that the accusers consciously transfer their own fabrication.
The hidden-agent model may be lexical disambiguation rather than an implicit standard for diagnosis.
Both outliers are deliberately branch-distant and should remain qualified activations rather than lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The accusation externalizes the accusers’ own cut and veil.** `ف ر ي/B002` is destructive splitting, `ج ن ن/B006` madness veiling the mind, `ض ل ل/B002` being hidden or disappearing, and `ب ع د/B003` creating distance. The binary charge—fabrication or veiling—is reversed by `بل` into their hiddenness and distance. Splitting names their severance of claim from truth; veiling blocks perception; distance stabilizes the result. The packet supplies reversal and these states; I infer that the accusation projects their own cognitive mechanism. The ayah reads as diagnostic reversal: what they allege about the messenger describes how their refusal makes the later outcome disappear from view.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:43 reactivates fabrication and veiling as public labels, and 34:54 reveals disturbing doubt as the condition that kept those labels operative.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Fabrication recast as restorative stitching.** `ف ر ي B001` supplies cutting in order to repair or stitch, alongside the ordinary false-fabrication branch `ف ر ي B003`. The accusation stands after total tearing in 34:7 and before the explicit piercing and linking of armor in 34:11. B001 gives the disputed speech a repair-craft shadow. The packet supplies tear and stitch; I infer that the accusers misrecognize restorative joining as invented construction. `أَفْتَرَىٰ` consequently carries an ironic alternative: what they call fabrication is framed as the work that reconnects what has been torn.

2. **Two opposed kinds of covering.** `ج ن ن B006` supplies madness as a veil over the mind, while `ج ن ن B008` supplies protective cover. The question invokes the first, but nearby armor-making in 34:11 activates the second. The branches assign covering either a disabling or preserving role. The packet supplies the accusation and protective craft; I infer that the speakers collapse those roles. `جِنَّةٌ` therefore reads as a charge of harmful veiling whose root also exposes their failure to recognize a saving cover.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:11 produced both later surprises at once: `س ر د B002` activated the repair-and-stitch image of F-R-Y, and broad armor activated protective `ج ن ن B008`. The accusation consequently became a double misreading of repair as fabrication and cover as impairment.

baseline.text: Allah hakkında yalan mı uydurdu, yoksa onda bir delilik mi var? Hayır; ahirete inanmayanlar azap ve uzak bir sapkınlık içindedir.

findings.text: Elçiye yöneltilen parçalama ve zihinsel örtülme suçlamaları, ahireti görünmez kılan uzak sapkınlığın aslında suçlayanların kendi algı düzeni olduğunu açığa çıkarır.
Uydurma suçlamasının, parçalananı onaran bir kesme ve dikme işini yanlış tanıdığı okuması, sonraki zırh anlatısına dayanır ve ayette yeterince sabitlenmez.
Delilik diye nitelenen örtünün aynı zamanda koruyucu bir örtüye işaret ettiği ve suçlayanların kurtarıcı korumayı zihinsel bozukluk sandığı okuması fazla dolaylıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kesmenin salt parçalama için değil, bir şeyi onarmak, dikmek veya üretime hazırlamak amacıyla yapıldığını açıkça belirtir. Derinin dikişe hazırlanması ve su tulumunun yapılması bu amaçlı kesme çekirdeğinin özel uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bozmak için yarma ve kesmeyi değil, onarım veya yapım amacı taşıyan kesmeyi kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın biçimlerin onarım amaçlı kesme anlamını korur; su tulumu yapma anlamını ise yalnızca kendi söz öbeğine bağlı bir uygulama olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi, özellikle deriyi, onarmak, dikmek veya bir eşya üretmek üzere kesip biçmektir; su tulumu hazırlama, bu işlemin yapım alanındaki özel bir uygulamasıdır.

facets.statement: Kesme işlemi bozmak için değil, onarım, dikiş veya yapım için gerçekleştirilir.
Deri, dikilip sağlamlaştırılmaya elverişli parçalar hâlinde kesilir.
Su tulumunu kesip biçerek meydana getirme, belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı yapım uygulamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, işlemin ayırt edici yönünü kesmenin amacıyla açıklar: nesne onarılacak, dikilecek veya yapılacaktır. Deri kesimi ve su tulumu üretimi bu yapıcı amacın somut uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: onarmak veya yapmak için kesip biçmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Onarım, dikiş ve üretim amacı taşıyan kesme işlemlerinin tamamını en kısa doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kesme işlemini ve onun onarım ya da yapım amacını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri parçalarının dikiş ve onarım için hazırlanmasını anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Deri kesimini ve dikişe hazırlama amacını eksiksiz korur.
error_profile.loses: Deri dışındaki nesneleri ve su tulumu yapma uygulamasını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca su tulumunun yapımını bildiren özel söz öbeğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kesip biçme yoluyla bir su tulumu meydana getirme işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel onarım ve dikiş için kesme kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda amaç nesneyi kullanılabilir hâle getirmek veya üretmektir; komşu dalda ise kesme eylemi bozucu, yaralayıcı ya da parçalayıcıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Deri, onarım veya yapım amacıyla kesilip biçilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Su tulumunun iki deri kenarı doğrudan dikilir ve üstten ikinci bir dikiş geçirilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki anlam da deri işçiliği ve su tulumu yapımı alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal malzemenin amaçlı kesilip hazırlanmasını anlatır; komşu dal ise hazırlanmış deri kenarlarını belirli bir yöntemle dikme işlemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Onarım sürecinin kesip biçme ve hazırlama aşaması öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yırtık kumaş veya deri dikilerek kapatılır ve yeniden birleştirilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da deri veya kumaşı onarma ve dikiş işçiliği alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal onarım amacı taşıyan kesmeye dayanır; komşu dalın çekirdeği, yırtığı dikişle kapatıp parçaları yeniden birleştirmektir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kesme ve yarmayı bozma yönüyle tanımlar; damarların kesilmesi, bir şeyin yarılması ve ardından kendiliğinden çatlayıp ayrılması bu çekirdeği somutlaştırır. Bu nedenle dal, onarım amaçlı kesmeden açıkça ayrılır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bozucu kesme ve yarılmayı kapsar; onarım, dikiş veya yapım amacı taşıyan kesme bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerde bozucu yarma korunur; damar kesme yalnızca kendi söz öbeğinin özel nesnesi, yarılma biçimleri ise sonuç durumu olarak ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bozacak, yaralayacak veya parçalayacak biçimde kesmek ya da yarmaktır; eylemin sonucu olarak nesne çatlayıp ayrılabilir.

facets.statement: Kesme veya yarma eylemi nesneyi bozma, yaralama ya da parçalama yönündedir.
Damarların veya bir hayvanın karnının kesilmesi, bozucu eylemin canlı bedendeki özel uygulamasıdır.
Kesilen nesnenin çatlayıp yarılması ve parçalarının ayrılması, eylemin ortaya çıkardığı sonuçtur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kesme ve yarmanın bozucu niteliğinde birleşir. Damarların kesilmesi ile nesnenin yarılıp ayrılması, eylemin özel nesnesini ve sonucunu gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Nesneyi bozan, yaralayan ya da parçalayan kesme ve yarma kullanımlarının ortak çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kesme veya yarma eylemini, bozucu yönünü ve ayrılma sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kesmenin nesneyi bozup parçaladığı genel eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bozucu kesme eylemini ve parçalama sonucunu açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Yalnızca çatlayıp ayrılma sonucunu bildiren kullanımı açıkça vermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin kesme sonrasında çatlayıp iki yana ayrıldığı sonuç bağlamlarında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Nesnenin yarılma ve ayrılma sonucunu doğal biçimde karşılar.
error_profile.loses: Eyleyenin bozucu kesme işlemini ve damar kesme uygulamasını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir nesne üzerinde gerçekleştirilen kesme işlemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kesmenin bozucu sonucunu kurucu özellik sayar; komşu dal ise aynı fiziksel işlemi onarım ve yapım amacıyla sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yarma, bozma yönüyle tanımlanır ve yarılıp ayrılma sonucunu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kesme, yok etme, öldürme ve kökünü kazıma sonucuna kadar genişleyebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bozarak yarmak ve bütünüyle kesip atmak
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kılıçla veya başka bir araçla yapılan zarar verici kesmeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın sınırı bozucu yarma ve çatlamadır; komşu dal daha genel kesmeyi, bütünüyle ortadan kaldırmayı ve öldürmeyi de içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kesmenin bozucu yönü ve nesnenin yarılması belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İp, salkım, söz veya ilişki gibi şeylerin kesilmesi ve sona ermesi de kapsanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinde de bir bütünlüğün kesme yoluyla bozulması veya ayrılması vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal fiziksel yarma ve bozmayı öne çıkarır; komşu dal fiziksel olmayan ilişkilerin ve konuşmanın kesilmesine kadar uzanan daha geniş bir kopma alanına sahiptir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, gerçek olmayan bir sözü veya suçlamayı üretme eylemini ve bunun ürünü olan yalan ile karalamayı birlikte verir. İnanç ve davranış alanındaki ağır yanlışlamalar, bu uydurma çekirdeğinin kullanım genişlemeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, asılsız söz veya suçlama uydurmayı kapsar; fiziksel kesme ile yalnızca şaşırtıcı ya da büyük olma anlamı dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Uydurma eylemi ve onun ürünü olan asılsız söz yalın biçimlerde korunur; yalan uydurma söz öbeği bu çekirdeğin nesnesi belirtilmiş özel kuruluşudur.

concept_map.definition: Gerçek olmayan bir söz, iddia veya suçlama üretip bunu doğruymuş gibi ileri sürmektir; ortaya çıkan şey yalan, karalama ya da ağır bir asılsız isnat olabilir.

facets.statement: Gerçek olmayan bir söz veya iddia bilinçli biçimde üretilir.
Uydurulan içerik bir kişiye yöneltilen asılsız suçlama veya karalama olabilir.
Kullanım, yalanın yanı sıra inançta ve davranışta ağır yanlış isnatlara kadar genişleyebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yalanın yaratılması ve asılsız bir iddianın ileri sürülmesi çekirdeğinde birleşir. Adlandırma hem uydurma eylemini hem de ortaya çıkan yalan veya karalamayı kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalan üretme, karalama ve ağır bir asılsız isnat ileri sürme kullanımlarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Asılsız içeriğin üretilmesini ve söz ya da suçlama olarak ileri sürülmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gerçek olmayan bir anlatı veya iddianın bilinçli biçimde üretildiği bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçek olmayan içeriğin bilinçli biçimde üretilmesi çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir kişiye yöneltilen karalama ve daha geniş ağır isnat kullanımlarını açıkça vermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Uydurulan içeriğin bir kişiyi karalamak için suçlama biçiminde ileri sürüldüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uydurma içeriği ve bunun bir kişiye suçlama olarak yöneltilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Belirli bir kişiye yönelmeyen genel yalan üretimini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yalan veya ağır bir asılsızlık uydurmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uydurma, yalanın yanında karalama ve ağır asılsız isnatları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Söz, anlatı, şiir ve soy bağı iddiası gibi belirli içeriklerin örneksiz kurulması öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da gerçek olmayan bir söz veya iddianın bilinçli biçimde üretilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal uydurulan içeriğin yalan ve suçlama niteliğini öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise sözün veya anlatının kurma ve düzme yoluyla meydana getirilmesine daha geniş örnekler verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Asılsız içeriğin üretilmesi eylemin merkezindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalanın suçlanan kişiyi veya işiteni şaşkına düşüren çirkinliği ve masuma yönelmesi belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da gerçeğe aykırı söz ve bir kimseye asılsız suç yöneltme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeği uydurma işlemidir; komşu dal, asılsız sözün masuma yönelmesini ve kişiyi şaşkına düşüren ağırlığını ayrıca kurucu sınır yapar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Suçlama veya yalanın gerçek dışı içerik olarak üretilmesi gerekir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ayıp arama, arkadan konuşma, şüphe ve kötü bir fiille suçlama, içerik uydurulmasa da kapsanabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişiye kötü bir fiil veya nitelik yükleme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal asılsız içeriğin yaratılmasına dayanır; komşu dal ise suçlama, ayıp izleme ve arkadan konuşma gibi daha geniş karalama davranışlarını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yapma veya uydurma niteliği, içeriğin gerçek dışı ve yanıltıcı olmasına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şey yalnızca şaşırtıcı veya çok büyük olduğu için nitelenebilir; yapma oluş yalnızca alternatif bir yorumdur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yapılmış veya uydurulmuş olma yorumu iki dal arasında sınırlı bir temas kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uydurma yalanın kurucu özelliğidir; komşu dalın temel yorumları şaşırtıcılık ve büyüklüktür, yapma olma ise bunların yanında yer alan bir yorumdur.

branches.source_phrase_ar: فرى فلان كذبا يفريه إذا خلقه (maqayis)؛ فرى يفري فلان الكذب إذا اختلقه والفرية الكذب والقذف (ayn)؛ فرى فلان كذبا إذا خلقه وافتراه اختلقه والاسم الفرية (sihah)؛ الافتراء في الإفساد أكثر وكذلك استعمل في القرآن في الكذب والشرك والظلم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir kesin nitelik vermek yerine şaşırtıcı, büyük ve yapılmış ya da düzülmüş olma yorumlarını yan yana aktarır. Dal korunabilir, ancak yapma olma yorumu doğrudan yalan uydurma anlamıyla özdeşleştirilmemeli ve şaşırtıcılık ile büyüklüğün alternatifleri olarak gösterilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal şaşırtıcı veya büyük bir şeyi niteler; yapılmış ya da düzülmüş olma yalnızca kaynaklarda verilen alternatif yorumdur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Niteleme biçiminin alternatif anlamları korunur; bir şeyin şaşırtıcı ya da büyük diye nitelenmesi ile hayret verici iş yapma söz öbeği birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi alışılmadık derecede şaşırtıcı veya büyük diye nitelemektir; belirli ifadede bunun yapılmış ya da düzülmüş bir şey olduğu yorumu da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Niteliğin temel yorumu, şeyin güçlü bir şaşkınlık uyandırmasıdır.
Aynı niteleme, şeyin çok büyük veya önemli olması biçiminde yorumlanır.
Belirli söz bağlamında şeyin yapılmış ya da düzülmüş olması da alternatif bir yorumdur.
Bir kimsenin işinde hayret verici bir başarı göstermesi ayrı bir söz öbeğiyle anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar şaşkınlık uyandıran bir şey veya iş çekirdeğinde buluşur. Bunun çok büyük, yapılmış ya da düzülmüş bir şey sayılması, aynı ifadenin yan yana aktarılan yorumlarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: şaşırtıcı, büyük ya da düzülmüş şey
concept_gloss.applicability: Kaynaklarda aynı niteleme için verilen şaşırtıcılık, büyüklük ve yapılmışlık yorumlarını birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Üç alternatif yorumu ve hayret verici iş yapma bağlantısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nitelemenin hayret uyandırma yönünün bağlamda baskın olduğu yerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Şeyin alışılmadık ölçüde şaşırtıcı olması yorumunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Büyüklük ve yapılmış ya da düzülmüş olma yorumlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nitelemenin büyüklük ve önem bildirdiği iş veya olay bağlamlarında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Şeyin veya işin olağanüstü büyüklüğünü ve önemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Şaşırtıcılık ve yapılmış ya da düzülmüş olma yorumlarını açıkça vermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin yaptığı işte olağanüstü ve şaşırtıcı bir sonuç ortaya koyduğu söz öbeğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişinin işiyle hayret uyandırması anlamını doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi büyük veya düzülmüş diye niteleyen kullanımları kapsamaz.

işinde hayret verici bir şey yapmak

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Şaşırtıcılık alanında iki dal örtüşür; bu dal ayrıca büyüklük ve yapılmışlık yorumlarını taşırken komşu dalın kartı bu ek sınırları içermez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şeyin büyük veya düzülmüş sayılması da olasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Şeyin yeni, daha önce görülmemiş veya alışılmadık olması belirgindir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da olağan dışı olduğu için şaşkınlık uyandıran şeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yenilik koşulu aramaz ve büyüklük ile yapılmışlık yorumlarına açıktır; komşu dal şaşırtıcılığı özellikle yenilik ve alışılmamışlıkla sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şaşırtıcı şeyin düzülmüş veya yapılmış olması bir yorum olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Büyük şaşkınlık özellikle ağır olay, olağanüstü şiir veya baskın bir kişi gibi örneklerle somutlaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da büyük ve şaşırtıcı olay ya da başarıları niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel nitelemeyi ve yapılmışlık yorumunu korur; komşu dal ağır olay ve olağanüstü kişi ya da söz örnekleriyle daha belirli bir kullanım alanı kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yapılmışlık yalnızca bir yorumdur; yalan veya yanıltma zorunlu değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gerçek olmayan sözün ya da suçlamanın bilinçli biçimde üretilmesi zorunludur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yapılmış veya düzülmüş olma yorumu iki dal arasında sınırlı bir anlam teması yaratır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal şaşırtıcı veya büyük bir şeyi de kapsar; komşu dalda ise asılsız içerik üretme ve onu doğruymuş gibi ileri sürme çekirdektir.
